entry.text: If current render pass instance was begun with vkCmdBeginRendering, the dynamicRenderingUnusedAttachments feature is not enabled, and VkRenderingInfo::pDepthAttachment->imageView was not VK_NULL_HANDLE, the value of VkPipelineRenderingCreateInfo::depthAttachmentFormat used to create the bound graphics pipeline must be equal to the VkFormat used to create VkRenderingInfo::pDepthAttachment->imageView
